name: GhOsT77 Security
description: Website fixes, monthly website upkeep, hacked-site cleanup, FAQ chatbot setup, and consent-only security reviews. Reviews are AI-assisted and human-approved written reports, not a penetration test, compliance certification, or guarantee of security.

contact.phone_label: Rebecca, AI receptionist, 24/7. Mention your business name.

disclaimer: No review or set of fixes can make a system completely secure. These pages and the linked terms are a plain-language draft, not legal advice.

services.name: Website Fix
services.description: One-time fixes for a site you own or manage: broken pages, links, and forms; mobile layout problems; missing security headers, where your host allows; HTTPS and certificate issues; a short written summary of what was changed.
services.work_starts_after: payment and a confirmed scope, including the site URL (and FAQ text for the chatbot)

services.name: Website Upkeep
services.description: A monthly check plus small fixes: monitoring of HTTPS and certificate expiry, security header checks, small fixes when something slips, a short status note each month. Cancel any time.
services.work_starts_after: payment and a confirmed scope, including the site URL (and FAQ text for the chatbot)

services.name: Hacked Site Cleanup
services.description: One-time cleanup of malware, spam injections, a defacement, or a browser security warning on one site you own. Written record, basic hardening you approve, help requesting a Google Safe Browsing review if a warning is showing. If a missed backdoor means the same infection is still there within 14 days, it is re-cleaned at no extra charge. Not a guarantee the site is safe or that Google will remove a warning.

services.name: FAQ Chatbot Setup
services.description: One-time setup of an embeddable question box for one website you own, answering from your FAQ text. Default answers use keyword matching; no paid API is required. Not a sales agent, phone or voice bot, or legal, medical, or financial advice. Live demo on the chatbot page.
services.work_starts_after: payment and a confirmed scope, including the site URL (and FAQ text for the chatbot)

services.name: FAQ Chatbot Care
services.description: Optional monthly care for one FAQ chatbot: FAQ updates you send and a check that the widget still loads. Cancel any time.
services.work_starts_after: payment and a confirmed scope, including the site URL (and FAQ text for the chatbot)

services.name: Quick security review
services.description: A fast written pass before launch or a sale. Covers security headers, TLS and certificate expiry, CORS, cookie flags, HTTP to HTTPS, exposed debug/admin/config paths, unauthenticated endpoint checks, known-vulnerable dependencies (OSV), committed secrets (redacted), and Python static analysis. Up to 1 public GitHub repo. AI-assisted and human-approved. Not a penetration test, certification, or guarantee.

services.name: Standard security review
services.description: Everything in Quick, plus login, session, password-reset and token handling checks with test accounts you provide, role-to-role access checks, OWASP Top 10 / API Top 10 style non-destructive checks, and one retest of fixed findings within 14 days. Prefer test or staging.

services.name: Deep security review
services.description: Everything in Standard, plus a step-by-step review of every in-scope endpoint and role (including business-logic abuse), source review of authentication, access control and input handling, threat notes, a prioritized fix plan, and one retest of fixed findings within 30 days.

services.name: Contract Security Scan
services.description: Related, optional, and separate from the website review packages. Read-only scan of a verified-source EVM contract for proxy/admin pattern, owner type, and privileged functions. Automated. Not financial advice, not a penetration test, and not one of the website or written-review packages on the Security marketing site.
services.work_starts_after: valid x402 payment; payment settles only after the job succeeds, as stated on the live services manifest
